# Trenston

> CEO Operating System. Run the business. Don't chase it.

Built for founders and owners running real operations — however lean the team.

Trenston is a CEO operating system: one cockpit for money, pipeline, people,
department work, and decisions — Briefing, Decision Center, Financials,
Ask Trenston, and department lanes (Production, Procurement, Legal, HR,
Maintenance, Sales).

## Canonical pages

- Home: https://www.trenston.com/
- Pricing (authoritative): https://www.trenston.com/pricing

- Security: https://www.trenston.com/security
- About: https://www.trenston.com/about
- Help: https://www.trenston.com/help

## Current pricing

Source of truth in the product repo: frontend/src/lib/marketingCopy.js (PLANS).
Do not use older docs (e.g. memory/PRD.md) or guessed figures.

- Free: $0 (3 seats) — Small teams trying Trenston
- Starter: $15/mo (7 seats) — Small businesses
- Growth: $39/mo (20 seats) — Growing businesses
- Business: $99/mo (35 seats) — Larger companies

Paid plans (Starter, Growth, Business) include a 7-day free trial.
Billing is via Paddle. Cancel anytime from Billing.
